A Confluence macro add-on for creating sequence diagrams from plain-text instructions.

Need to attach sequence diagrams to Jira issues? Check out Sequence Diagrams for Jira

text.moreDetails:
If the diagram doesn't display properly, it is usually due to a syntax error. Some common errors include:

  • You specified a title for your diagram (e.g. "title: ", but forgot to include a colon after the word "title"
  • You specified participants (e.g. "participant Bob"), but included a colon after the word "participant"

If you have trouble getting your diagram to display, try starting with a simple diagram first (eg. "A->B: test diagram"), and make sure that displays before gradually adding more partipants, notes or message.

Better syntax checking and error handling will be coming in a future version of the plugin, to assist with creating valid diagrams.

If the diagram doesn't display properly, it is usually due to a syntax error. Some common errors include:

  • You specified a title for your diagram (e.g. "title: ", but forgot to include a colon after the word "title"
  • You specified participants (e.g. "participant Bob"), but included a colon after the word "participant"

If you have trouble getting your diagram to display, try starting with a simple diagram first (eg. "A->B: test diagram"), and make sure that displays before gradually adding more partipants, notes or message.

Better syntax checking and error handling will be coming in a future version of the plugin, to assist with creating valid diagrams.
